answer: The summit counter is kept in tide and karst shows each reset. An attacker hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3875 identities would post 3477 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
